coverage_limits: The target court's final reasoning, condition states, supports/defeats determinations, verdict, and target adoption are withheld and are not inferred.

The approved spans contain materially conflicting pre-target accounts concerning who possessed, controlled, opened, closed, and carried on business in the shop; those conflicts are preserved rather than reconciled.
The supplied spans do not establish that respondent no. 2 and Sanjeev Kumar are the same person, so no such identity is inferred.
Speaker attribution is not explicit in several approved spans; party_side is therefore left UNKNOWN where the supplied text does not identify the speaker.

The supplied spans do not independently establish the existence or absence of written landlord consent, rent or other tenancy incidents between respondent no. 1 and respondent no. 2, or a divestment of respondent no. 1's legal possession.
Statements that the son helped or only assisted his father do not, on the supplied excerpts alone, establish the identity of every pronoun referent or resolve the possession dispute.
